items.html: And nevertheless, we shall return and arrange them here: from the lower half of the Tifferet of Arich was made in ZA the Mochin of Hochma, and from the Yesod, the Mochin of Bina. And the two upper joints of the Netzah-Hod remained forever at the Chazeh of AVI, in the place of the breasts, as above. And from the middle joint of the Netzah were made the Hesed and the Netzah of ZA; and from the middle joint of the Hod were made the Gevura and the Hod of ZA; and from the lower joint of the Netzah were made the Tifferet and the Yesod of ZA; and from the lower joint of the Hod was made the Nukva of ZA.
